name: Braxat Lord
tactics: A braxat is a clever, wicked, and patient foe. It smashes the bones of its enemies with mighty swings of its weapon and uses its mental powers to prevent the broken victims from escaping before they can be finished off.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Threatening Reach
traits.details: The lord can make opportunity attacks against enemies within 3 squares of it.

hit.description: damage, and the lord slides the target 2 squares.

effect.description: The target is marked until the end of the lord’s next turn.

powers.name: Crushing Pain
powers.description: The target is slowed until the end of the lord’s next turn.

hit.description: psychic damage, and the target is immobilized until the end of the lord’s next turn.

aftereffects.name: Aftereffect
aftereffects.description: The target is slowed until the end of the lord’s next turn.

effect.description: The lord uses maul twice and crushing pain, making the attacks against two or three targets.

hit.description: acid damage, and ongoing 15 acid damage (save ends). The blast’s area is difficult terrain and is lightly obscured until the end of the lord’s next turn. Any creature that ends its turn in the area before the end of the lord’s next turn takes 10 acid damage.

attacks.name: Attack
attacks.targets: creatures in the burst marked by the lord

hit.description: psychic damage, and the target grants combat advantage and cannot take immediate actions or opportunity actions (save ends both).

powers.name: Telekinetic Harness
powers.trigger: An enemy marked by the lord ends its turn in a square that is not adjacent to the lord.

effect.description: The lord pulls the triggering enemy 6 squares, and the target is restrained and takes ongoing 15 psychic damage (save ends both).
